# pkgs — Arch Linux aarch64 Package Repository

> Optimized Arch Linux aarch64 package repository for Raspberry Pi 5 (Cortex-A76). Packages are built on native ARM64 GitHub runners with cortex-a76 + crypto optimizations and 16K page alignment, then deployed to `pkgs.dryam.ru`.

Critical notes:

- This is a **third-party** repository, not the official Arch Linux ARM repository. Add it above ALARM in pacman.conf.
- All packages and the repo database are GPG-signed (RSA 4096). SigLevel = Required TrustedOnly is enforced.
- The repo uses 16K ELF page alignment (`-Wl,-z,max-page-size=0x4000`) for compatibility with the linux-rpi-16k kernel.
- Repository maintenance is AI-agent-driven via GitHub Issues and the opencode skill system.

## Packages

- [atuin](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/atuin): Shell history with sync
- [bat](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/bat): cat(1) clone with wings
- [delta](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/delta): Syntax-highlighting pager for git
- [dust](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/dust): More intuitive version of du
- [dysk](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/dysk): ls-like command for disks
- [erd](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/erd): Modern filesystem and disk-usage utility
- [eza](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/eza): Modern maintained replacement for ls
- [fd](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/fd): Simple, fast alternative to find
- [fzf](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/fzf): Command-line fuzzy finder
- [grex](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/grex): Command-line tool for generating regex
- [helix](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/helix): Modal terminal-based text editor
- [hyperfine](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/hyperfine): Command-line benchmarking tool
- [just](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/just): Command runner
- [just-lsp](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/just-lsp): Language server for just
- [kmscon](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/kmscon): KMS/DRM-based virtual console
- [linux-rpi-16k](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/linux-rpi-16k): Raspberry Pi 5 kernel (16K pages, RPi Foundation fork)
- [marksman](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/marksman): Markdown LSP server
- [mdv](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/mdv): Browser-quality Markdown viewer for terminal
- [mozillavpn](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/mozillavpn): Fast, secure VPN by Mozilla
- [procs](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/procs): Modern replacement for ps
- [ripgrep](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/ripgrep): Fast grep replacement (binary: rg)
- [starship](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/starship): Minimal, blazing-fast prompt for any shell
- [taplo](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/taplo): TOML toolkit
- [zellij](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/zellij): Terminal workspace with batteries included
- [zoxide](http://pkgs.dryam.ru/aarch64/zoxide): Smarter cd command

## CI

- [build.yml](https://github.com/dryamovvv/pkgs/blob/main/.github/workflows/build.yml): Package build matrix with Docker, ccache, and artifact caching
- [opencode.yml](https://github.com/dryamovvv/pkgs/blob/main/.github/workflows/opencode.yml): AI agent workflows (builder, review, analysis)
- [lint.yml](https://github.com/dryamovvv/pkgs/blob/main/.github/workflows/lint.yml): namcap + markdownlint + sha256sums validation
